items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: He worked with me. He worked with a gang in my job. But I worked with him all his job.

ctx.x: He worked with me. He worked with a gang in my job. But I worked with him all his job. All his job.
I'm trying to remember who was at Thump and Manny's and the Lyon Centers and different places. Used to see you uptown. Andy. Andy? Howard. Sometimes Andrew Morgan too.
Andrew Morgan, Andrew Morgan worked up there a long time. Yeah.
